title: The input of a compact MCP surface's execute tool (DEC-0180 CM-4)
description: The arguments of the execute tool a compact MCP surface names in surfaces.mcp.compact.execute: the capability to run, its arguments (valid against the input schema search answers for it) and an idempotency key. The service runs the capability as a call by its own name: the same authorization, action gate, idempotency and audit (CM-5); a relayed decision travels in the call's _meta.decision as for the capability's own tool (DEC-0121 AP-2). A name the surface does not serve is refused unknown-operation, arguments its input schema refuses invalid-arguments (CM-4). docs/specification/service.md#compact-mcp-surface-dec-0180.

operation.description: The capability to run, a name search answers (CM-4).

idempotencyKey.description: The key the capability's own tool takes; a retry with the same key and arguments answers the first result (CM-4, CM-5).
